jobs.title: WordPress Theme & Plugin Developer
jobs.jd_full:
About the Role

We're seeking a talented Fullstack WordPress Developer with strong expertise in custom theme and plugin development. You'll work on WordPress projects, including theme and plugin development, and potentially some Joomla projects (with appropriate support, depending on your familiarity).

This is a contract role for full-time work over a 5 month contract.

However, you'll work as if you were a full-time employee, participating in team meetings, communicating via Slack, and coordinating with other people on our team.

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Build custom WordPress themes that closely match designs with meticulous attention to detail
  • Develop custom WordPress plugins with clean, well-structured code
  • Take ownership of WordPress projects from concept to completion
  • Refactor and update existing themes and templates
  • Address other occasional full-stack developer tasks as needed for non-WordPress systems and situations (e.g. newsletter development)
  • Provide limited support for clients who have issues or problems (secondary responsibility)

 

Work Hours & Meetings

You must be available to participate in meetings between 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM Los Angeles time (UTC-8)

Your work hours will be negotiable. However, this is a full-time position, and the condition of this contract work is that you only work on our projects and on a full-time basis. Preference will be given to candidates that can closely align with our US timezone schedule.

You have:

  1. At least 4 years of experience building custom WordPress themes and plugins
  2. Strong front-end development skills with an eye for detail
  3. Deep understanding of code organization, patterns, and OOP
  4. Strong English communication skills (written and verbal)
  5. The ability to work independently and complete objectives without explicit direction
  6. The ability to deliver polished work, self-review, and catch bugs before others do. This means that for any front-end development you do, it should be near pixel-perfect in alignment with the design you're working from.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Sales Field Operations, Americas
jobs.jd_full:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

The Director of AMER Enterprise Sales Field Operations is the primary operations partner to the VP of AMER Enterprise Sales. You will own the operating rhythm of the region: forecasting, pipeline generation and inspection, and business reviews. You will also shape the region's go-to-market strategy, expansion plans, and capacity model. In this role, you will act as the COO to the VP of AMER Enterprise Sales, ensuring our business is growing efficiently and effectively. You need to think strategically about the Enterprise business, understanding the implications of changing market and team dynamics and proactively developing solutions that enable us to win.

You will lead a team of three field operations managers and analysts. Success in this role means a more accurate forecast, a healthier pipeline, measurable gains in rep productivity, and increasing ARR across AMER Enterprise. The work you do will shape how Fivetran grows in the Americas.

This role sits within the GTM Strategy and Operations organization.

What You’ll Do

Forecasting and pipeline

  • Own the AMER Enterprise forecast process, including call methodology, roll-up, and accuracy tracking against commit and best case, giving leadership a number they can commit to with confidence.

  • Drive pipeline generation planning: with the marketing, partner, and sales leadership teams set coverage targets by segment and source, track progress, and flag gaps early enough to act, so each quarter starts with the pipeline needed to hit plan.

  • Run pipeline inspection with sales leadership, focusing on deal quality, stage progression, and slippage, so risk surfaces while there is still time to save the deal.

Operating cadence and performance management

  • Design and run the region's operating cadence: weekly forecast calls, pipeline reviews, monthly business reviews, and quarterly business reviews.

  • Continuously refine those cadences so they drive decisions rather than reporting.

  • Run AE performance reviews with frontline and second-line managers, using consistent metrics to identify coaching needs and performance risk, so managers act on facts rather than anecdotes.

  • Identify and prioritize the metrics the field uses to run the business, and partner with GTM Analytics to build and maintain the supporting dashboards, giving every leader in the region a shared view of performance.

  • Lead deep-dive investigations into performance questions, and turn findings into specific recommendations that change how the region sells.

Regional strategy

  • Shape GTM strategy and org structure for AMER Enterprise by region and sales motion, setting the team up to win as enterprise AI demand grows.

  • Build the analysis behind regional expansion decisions, such as which territories to enter next and in what sequence, so we invest where the opportunity is largest.

  • Design region- and motion-specific SPIFFs, then measure whether they changed behavior and results.

Annual planning and capacity (in partnership with Strategy and Planning)

  • Support quota setting for the region, bringing field context to top-down targets so quotas are both ambitious and attainable.

  • Support and refine territory carving so territories are balanced and match the coverage model.

  • Pressure-test assumptions in the bottoms-up headcount model and coverage ratios, so hiring plans reflect real field performance.

  • Validate rep productivity and ramp assumptions against actual performance data.

Team leadership

  • Lead, hire, and develop a team of field operations managers and analysts and grow them into strategic partners to sales leadership.

  • Set clear priorities for the team and allocate its capacity against the needs of AMER Enterprise leadership.

Who you'll work with

  • VP of AMER Enterprise Sales and their leadership team: your primary stakeholders and day-to-day partners.

  • Strategy and Planning: annual plan, quota, territory, and capacity modeling.

  • Revenue Operations: CRM, systems, process, and data integrity.

  • GTM Analytics: dashboards, reporting, and analytical deep dives.

  • Enablement: onboarding, ramp, and skill gaps surfaced through performance reviews.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years in sales operations, sales strategy, management consulting, or a related analytical role, including 4+ years supporting enterprise sales teams directly.

  • 4+ years managing people, ideally analysts or operations managers.

  • Track record of owning a forecast process and improving its accuracy.

  • Experience running sales operating cadences and business reviews with senior sales leaders.

  • Working knowledge of annual planning: quota setting, territory design, capacity and coverage modeling, and ramp assumptions.

  • Strong analytical skills, including building models in spreadsheets and working with CRM and BI data (for example, Salesforce, Tableau, Looker, or SQL).

  • Ability to turn analysis into a clear recommendation and defend it with sales leaders.

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with a consumption-based or usage-based pricing model.

  • Experience designing sales incentive programs or SPIFFs.

  • Experience supporting regional expansion or new-segment launches.

  • Prior experience as the dedicated operations partner to a regional sales leader.

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

jobs.title: Director AI Native Product Builder | New Ventures
jobs.jd_full:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Director AI Native Product Builder in our New Ventures area in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

Wellhub serves millions of members today. The next generation of wellness experiences they are waiting for (deeper personalization, integrated journeys across fitness, longevity and emotional wellbeing) does not yet exist inside our walls. New Ventures exists to build those products, at AI speed. Small squads own each bet end-to-end, from earliest hypothesis through validation, MVP, and scale. Every prototype starts with AI, and every workflow is rebuilt around it.

You will report directly to the Founder/GM of the bet you join and lead its builders as part of a small, single-threaded squad. You own the build end-to-end, minimizing friction and rethinking traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering. You will work daily with the Founder/GM, the bet's product manager, data and design craft leads, and a fleet of AI agents. This is a player-coach role: you lead people, and you are still in the work, directing AI to ship. The methods we prove in New Ventures are the methods that will shape future bets, and your work will connect directly to Wellhub's company goals: be loved, be global, be fit.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Lead the build for your bet: take ambiguous problems from earliest hypothesis to a production-grade MVP and into scale, end-to-end.
  • Make AI the product fabric: embed AI as the core mechanic of the member experience, not a feature bolted on top, so the product would be impossible to recreate without it.
  • Compress cycle time: the metric that defines us is days from member insight to shipped experiment. Ship working prototypes in days and production-grade increments in weeks, and set the pace the squad has to match.
  • Set the AI-native bar for the squad: define the context, agents, prompts, evals, and ways of working every builder in the bet operates at, and make the bar visible by shipping above it yourself.
  • Build foundations that compound: when a pattern (agent harness, eval framework, prompt library, shared context) is reusable, extract it and make it the default, so the next builder in New Ventures doesn't re-solve what you already shipped.
  • Lead and grow the builders in the bet: hire, coach, and develop the team. Run the rituals that pull everyone up the AI curve (pair, demo, document, teach). Before approving a hire, show why AI couldn't do the work.
  • Own quality and safety in production: partner with the product manager on evals and guardrails, so we know the AI is good enough before members do, and sensitive data is handled with care.
  • Stand behind kill decisions: when an experiment or a direction doesn't pan out, say so early. Killing on time is part of how a healthy portfolio operates.
  • Bring product taste and founder mentality: call great products great and bad products bad, make decisions with incomplete information, and move toward the unknown rather than away from it.
  • Live the mission: care for your own wellbeing and your colleagues', and build a team where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experience shipping consumer or B2B SaaS products, hybrid by craft: deep fluency in product craft (discovery, UX, instrumentation, iteration) and modern engineering (architecture, systems, full-stack thinking). The combination is the role.
  • Shipped products to production at meaningful scale, from earliest hypothesis through validation, MVP, and scale, and comfortable killing a hypothesis that didn't pan out.
  • Deep, hands-on AI fluency: you use modern AI tooling (AI-assisted IDEs, agent frameworks, LLM APIs) every day, and hold strong, evidence-backed opinions on prompts, evals, retrieval, and model selection.
  • Fluent across the AI-native disciplines: context engineering as infrastructure, agentic development as your primary execution model (direct, execute, review, iterate), and vibe coding to compress build-measure-learn. You can teach all three.
  • Experience leading a team of builders or engineers as a player-coach: you teach by pairing, demoing, and documenting, and you don't delegate the interesting work and review slides about it.
  • Customer-centric to the core: you can name the customer problem behind every product you've shipped, in the customer's own words.
  • Bias to ship, with taste: you ship Monday and iterate Tuesday, and you know which corners cannot be cut.
  • Comfortable operating without a playbook: you push back when the data says so, change your mind fast when shown new evidence, and are comfortable being a beginner again on the things AI changes every month.
  • Advanced English required; you'll work daily with stakeholders across BR, US, and EU.

Nice to have:

  • Background in health, fitness, or wellbeing products.
  • Experience building AI products that handle sensitive personal or health data.
  • A track record of pulling a team or an organization toward a new way of working.
  • Exposure to products operating across multiple countries and languages.
  • Advanced Portuguese.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that deep hands-on fluency with modern AI tooling and concepts (AI-assisted development, agent frameworks, LLM APIs, evals, prompt design), a track record of shipping consumer or B2B products at scale, and advanced English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.

jobs.title: Specialty Pharmacy Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Careers with real impact.

Every role at Orsini moves a patient closer to life-changing therapy. We partner with biopharma innovators, healthcare providers, and payers to make access simple, compassionate, and reliable - so no patient is left behind. Make your next role matter.

ABOUT ORSINI

Providing compassionate care since 1987, Orsini is a leader in rare disease and gene therapy pharmacy solutions, built to simplify how patients connect to advanced medicines. Through our comprehensive commercialization solutions including a nationwide specialty pharmacy, patient services hub, home infusion and nursing network, and third-party logistics provider, we work with biopharma, providers, and payors to ensure No Patient is Left Behind™.

OUR MISSION

Orsini is on a mission to be the essential partner for biopharma innovators, healthcare providers, and payers to support patients and their families in accessing revolutionary treatments for rare diseases. Through our integrated portfolio of services, we seek to pioneer comprehensive solutions that simplify how patients connect to advanced therapies while providing holistic, compassionate care so that No Patient is Left Behind™.

CORE VALUES

At the heart of our company culture, the Orsini LIVE IT Core Values serve as guiding principles that shape how we interact with each other and those we serve. These values are the driving force behind our commitment to excellence, collaboration, and genuine care in every aspect of our work.

LOCATION

The salary for this position is $75,000.

This is a remote position.


POSITION SUMMARY

This position will be the primary account manager for assigned manufacturers to drive design, implementation, communication, and management of specialty pharmacy therapy programs, including rare diseases, that deliver value for manufacturers. The program manager will develop, document, and manage relationships across the assigned organization with the goal to grow the partnership with Orsini Specialty Pharmacy. The program manager will be the project manager of drug launches (implementation) within Orsini and work with internal Orsini stakeholders and Senior Management to manage Orsini Specialty Pharmacy performance/manufacturer key performance indicators (KPIs) and grow Orsini's share of business within the assigned manufacturer. This position will manage contractual deliverables and assist in resolving customer service escalations. The role requires consistent travel for quarterly business reviews, manufacturer meetings, and other business engagements as needed.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES
  • Oversee, develop, and manage therapy/service programs for designated pharma partners and/or therapy classes. Manage Orsini therapy performance/manufacturer KPI(s), document communications, and assist with any manufacturer escalated issues.
  • Develop and manage relationships across the assigned manufacturer organization with the goal to grow the partnership and Orsini Specialty Pharmacy share of the business.
  • Lead cross-functional team to develop and implement custom programs for Pharma partners and/or for new specialty pharmacy product launches. This includes designing clinical and operational processes to support needs of product, educating the Orsini Healthcare staff to ensure all teams are prepared for new product or service launches.
  • Implementation and on-going oversight of trade contract deliverables including data reporting development and issue resolution. Participate in quarterly business reviews with manufacturers when requested.
  • Work collaboratively to assess and improve key clinical and operational processes within Specialty Pharmacy. Participate in quality improvement activities as assigned.
  • Prepare reports regarding program performance (financial & operational outcomes), ongoing activities, projects, and other reporting needs for customer business review meetings.
  • Lead cross-functional team to manage strategically important projects (internal/ manufacturer).
  • Perform other duties or projects as assigned.

This job description is not designed to contain or be interpreted as totally comprehensive of every job duty, responsibility, or qualification required by an employee assigned to this job. While employed in this position, an employee may be required to perform other assignments not listed in this job description.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND TRAINING
  • Bachelor’s degree in related field required, or an equivalent combination of education, skills and experience (minimum 5-8 years in a relevant role).
  • Previous Specialty Pharmacy Trade experience at lager organization preferred.
  • Experience with account management and internal stakeholder collaboration preferred.
  • Must be computer literate – knowledge of Outlook, Excel, Word, Power Point, and Visio
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to read, analyze, interpret professional literature and technical procedures.
  • Ability to identify, analyze, and solve complex problems.
  • Ability to interpret and make inferences from data.
  • Good project management skills.
  • Ability to respond to changing priorities and handle multiple tasks at one time.
  • Ability to travel for QBRs, implementations, pharma partner meetings, and other business engagement meetings as needed.

jobs.title: Accounting Technical Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Description

Guesty is the all-in-one platform helping hospitality businesses around the world automate, optimize, and scale their operations. We’re a fast-growing global startup that’s transforming how the industry works — from guest experience to business growth.

With a powerful suite of features and integrations with 150+ industry partners — including Airbnb, Vrbo, , Expedia, Google Travel, and many more — Guesty empowers property managers to deliver top-tier guest experiences while running more efficient, data-driven operations.

We’re proud to have over 900+ team members across 16 countries worldwide, all working together to build the future of hospitality technology.

If you’re looking to grow your career in a dynamic, global, and impact-driven environment, we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking for a Accounting Technical Program Manager to join our team. This role is open to candidates based remotely in Canada or the United States. Candidates located in the New York area will follow a hybrid schedule, with an expectation to work from our New York office two days per week.

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) specializing in Accounting, you will serve as the dedicated Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the Guesty Accounting Module. In this role, you will act as a key technical and financial partner to our Enterprise and Strategic customers, guiding them through complex accounting workflows, owner statements, and critical end-of-month financial processes.

Beyond enterprise support, you will drive proactive product adoption, ensuring clients achieve the financial optimization necessary for long-term retention and expansion. You will work in close strategic partnership with the Customer Success Management (CSM) team to analyze client workflows, identify adoption gaps, and safeguard account health.

Internally, you will serve as the definitive "Voice of the Customer" to our Product and Engineering teams—advocating for enterprise financial needs to shape our product roadmap. Additionally, you will be the backbone of accounting expertise for the broader TPM team, handling advanced accounting escalations and driving ongoing team enablement on best practices and new features.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

Enterprise Partnership & Product Adoption

  • Month-End Financial Support: Provide dedicated guidance to enterprise and strategic accounts during high-stakes end-of-month closing cycles, ensuring smooth reconciliations, payouts, and statement generation.
  • Proactive Product Adoption: Analyze enterprise accounting setups to drive deeper feature utilization, streamline financial workflows, and increase overall product stickiness and retention.
  • CSM Strategic Partnership: Partner closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) on shared strategic accounts to align technical and accounting excellence with overall client retention and health goals.
  • Advanced Accounting Consultations: Lead complex consultations for enterprise clients to translate intricate property management accounting requirements into optimized Guesty Accounting Module configurations.

Internal Enablement & Voice of the Customer

  • Voice of the Customer (VoC): Synthesize real-world client challenges, accounting feedback, and market requirements to advocate directly with Product and Engineering teams for strategic roadmap enhancements.
  • Accounting Escalations SME: Act as the primary escalation point for the technical program management team on complex accounting, ledger, and reconciliation discrepancies.
  • Team Enablement & Training: Lead continuous enablement for internal team regarding new feature releases, property management accounting best practices, and operational standards.

﻿﻿Key Skills:

  • ﻿Accounting & Financial SME: Deep functional knowledge of property management accounting, trust accounting, owner payout statements, ledgers, bank reconciliations, and month-end closing processes.
  • Technical Aptitude: A solid background in navigating complex SaaS environments and a natural ability to master intricate technical use cases.
  • Strategic Problem-Solving: The ability to analyze customer configurations and workflows to provide optimal, scalable solutions.
  • Expert Communication & Training: Exceptional presentation skills with a talent for translating dense technical concepts into simple, actionable guidance for both clients and internal teams.
  • SaaS Product Advocacy: Experience collaborating with Product organizations to vocalize feature requests, provide tangible feedback, and advocate for impactful roadmap releases.
  • Proactive Drive: High level of initiative to identify adoption gaps, improve customer setup, and collect meaningful product feedback.
  • Analytical Thinking: The ability to identify trends across account cohorts and use data to track evolving product needs.
  • Adaptability & Evolution: A proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and a proactive embrace of change—whether adopting new internal tools, evolving systems, or leveraging developing automations to improve efficiency.
  • (Bonus) Market Knowledge: Familiarity with the short-term rental market, the OTA landscape (Airbnb, Vrbo, etc.), and the property management software ecosystem.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience within the SaaS software industry or in a technology-driven environment
  • Deep hands-on experience with trust accounting, property management accounting, or financial SaaS platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience handling enterprise/strategic accounts during high-pressure financial cycles (e.g., month-end close).
  • API literacy
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and creative thinking
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with cross-functional teams

jobs.jd_full:
This currently is not an active position requisition. We are accepting applications for this position on an ongoing basis for an active pipeline for when they become available.

ABOUT NEW SOLUTIONS
Selected as the #1 "Best Nonprofit to Work for" in 2024 by The NonProfit Times, NEW Solutions helps federal government agencies to accomplish their mission by providing skilled and experienced workers in professional, administrative, technical and scientific positions.

JOB SUMMARY

Oversees operations and activities in support of the program(s); ensures the delivery of timely, high quality, and cost-effective services to participating States. Works with the Program Director to improve the organization's capacity to serve, manage, and deliver experienced worker employment programs.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assists in managing all aspects of the program operations and activities. Serves as secondary point of contact for the program(s). Provides oversight, support, and guidance to Recruiters/Program Specialists.
  • Provides input to program materials such as handbook, resource materials, web pages, etc.; develops training opportunities for program personnel. Provides support and improvements to the program website.
  • Provides ongoing support, guidance, and assistance to Coordinators, Monitors, Grants/Agreements Staff, and Budget Specialists.
  • Works closely with the Coordinators to promote and grow the program.
  • Creates and maintains consistent communication with current clients and program leaders (e.g. monthly newsletters).
  • Conducts periodic outreach visits with staff involved with the program to promote the program and build relationships.
  • Conducts educational sessions for stakeholders.

QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

  • Operational experience with non-profit, for-profit, and government sectors desired, with preference for demonstrated ability to implement and manage government grant programs.
  • Demonstrated ability to serve on and lead successful business and/or program teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and use program support systems and tools.
  • Demonstrated success as collaborator and problem solver.
  • Written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience handling multiple priorities effectively.
  • Project and people management skills.
  • Experience with HR and/or workforce planning and projects preferred.

The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Credit
jobs.jd_full:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.

We chose hard problems on purpose.

We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You’ll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it’s the steepest learning curve of your career.

Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.

If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to be the single owner of our credit business: its growth, its economics, and how it runs day to day. You’ll set the metrics that matter, design the product from application through collections, and work with compliance, treasury, and capital markets so the business can scale. Why this role now: we are growing credit usage in the markets where we already operate, and we are launching credit in the US and Spain. You will own those launches and make sure they are compliant from day one.

 

Location: This role is remote or hybrid based out of Bogotá, Colombia, and is a full-time remote position where it is also possible to come into our office in the Parque de la 93 area on a flexible schedule. #LI-HYBRID

What you’ll own — Economics and growth

  • Credit economics: pricing, fees, rewards cost, utilization, losses, and portfolio profitability.
  • Growth: credit adoption, activation, and usage, and how credit drives use of the rest of Jeeves.

What you’ll own — The credit lifecycle, from application to collections

  • Application and lines: the application and approval experience, line assignment, limit increases and decreases, sub-limits, and multiple lines per company.
  • Draw controls: when customers can use their line, when we stop them, and how we tell them why.
  • Statements and billing: cycles, interest, fees, rewards, disclosures, and country-specific tax and invoicing.
  • Repayment: collection across local rails and auto-debit, and applying each payment correctly across statements and lines.
  • Collections and recovery: delinquency states, freezes, retries, digital collection, recovery, and charge-off.

What you’ll own — Compliance, capital, and risk data

  • Compliance and capital: turning regulatory, legal, and lender requirements into product, working with compliance, treasury, and capital markets.
  • Risk data: the data and pipelines our credit team uses to approve and monitor customers.

In your first year

  • Set credit metrics and targets, and report on them to leadership.
  • Grow credit usage across existing markets.
  • Fully automate payment application, including for customers with multiple lines.
  • Launch auto-debit repayment, with clear rules for failed debits.
  • Consolidate draw controls into one decision point with clear reasons.
  • Launch credit products in the US and Spain, compliant from day one.

What we’re looking for — Must-haves

  • 5+ years in product management, including 2+ years owning a lending or card-credit product.
  • Fluency in credit metrics: approval rates, line assignment, utilization, vintage curves, delinquency, charge-offs, interchange, and rewards cost.
  • A track record of growing a credit product, with results you can measure.
  • Experience designing payment application or reconciliation logic, including edge cases.
  • Sound judgment in regulated products, and the ability to turn legal and lender requirements into clear specs.
  • A habit of experimenting and deciding with data. Strong SQL.
  • You use AI tools in your day-to-day work (research, writing specs, analysis) and can identify where AI belongs in the credit product itself.
  • Clear communication of tradeoffs to executives and partners.
  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English. You’ll work daily with teams and partners across the US, Europe, and Latin America.

  • Experience building or owning credit products in Latin America, the US, or Spain.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Product Manager, FinOps

As a Senior Platform Product Manager for FinOps, you will drive the vision, roadmap, and product outcomes for how Datadog understands and acts on its infrastructure costs. Your customers are Datadog’s engineers, Finance team and product managers. You will make complex cost data useful in their daily decisions: what changed, why it changed, what happens next, and what to do about it. You will enable intuitive cost allocation, explanation, and forecasting experiences, and connect internal needs with Datadog’s Cloud Cost Management product.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own discovery, strategy, and prioritization for internal FinOps products. Understand the distinct decisions Engineering, Finance, executives, and PMs need to make, and validate which problems are most valuable to solve.
  • Make cost allocation understandable and actionable, including shared-platform costs, service consumption, and product and customer margins. Embed cost views into the core platforms, dashboards, and workflows teams already use.
  • Improve the cost-explanation experience so teams can quickly understand cost changes, identify their causes, distinguish ongoing costs from temporary changes, and project timelines for expected cost corrections. Where current processes depend on a mandate, build the product that teams will choose to use, then retire the mandate.
  • Make the underlying metrics self-serve so teams track their own costs, and reduce the review to the decisions that need a room.
  • Partner with engineering on timely detection, insights, monitors, and alerts, and support the Engineering-ownership program that puts cost explanation on Engineering leaders.
  • Shape forecasting tools with Finance and FinOps around shared data, visible assumptions, and traceable scenarios. Help teams use cost data for capacity, efficiency, and resource-planning decisions.
  • Bridge FinOps and CCM product roadmaps by 1) running joint roadmap reviews with the CCM product team to identify overlapping builds before work starts, and 2) deciding what to reuse, where internal needs justify new capabilities, and which validated internal solutions could benefit external customers.
  • Lead pilots with representative users, test usability, and use feedback and adoption evidence to guide broader rollouts.
  • Define baselines and success measures for adoption, time to explain cost changes, manual effort, allocation coverage and trust, and adoption of forecast tooling, with assumptions traceable to source. Use these measures to prioritize work and show how the product improves decisions.

Who You Are:

  • You have prior product management experience owning discovery, prioritization, and shipped outcomes, plus substantial hands-on FinOps or cloud cost-management experience.
  • You understand cost allocation, shared infrastructure economics, forecasting, and the different questions engineering and finance teams ask of the same cost data. You can reason about efficiency, usage growth, and product or customer margins.
  • You can turn complex data and technical systems into clear product experiences. You’ve worked directly with users, tested your assumptions, and improved adoption or reduced effort through what you shipped.
  • You bring strong analytical and systems thinking. You can interrogate cost and usage data, challenge assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and define measures that help teams decide what to do next.

  • You’re curious about how AI is changing infrastructure economics and product work. You continuously evaluate and use the latest tools to learn and test ideas quickly, and apply judgment to data quality, attribution, and the reliability of automated outputs.

jobs.jd_full:
At gFiber, we believe that great internet has the power to drive innovation, strengthen communities, enable the impossible, and do all the everyday things that make all of our world go round. And the job of creating better internet is never done - so we’re growing! Our team is committed to building a place where people who want to make a difference can grow their careers and find their spot to belong.

The application window will be open until at least November 29th, 2026 This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

 

Role Description:

As a Digital Content Program Manager, you will lead the creation, structure, and management of digital content within Contentful CMS. Working at the intersection of Digital, Brand and Engineering, you will ensure all web experiences align with design specifications, technical standards, and strategic goals while maintaining brand consistency.

 

In this role, you’ll:

  • Develop and implement effective content models within Contentful.
  • Author, edit, and publish high-quality, accurate content.
  • Collaborate closely with Brand and Engineering teams to ensure alignment with visual design and technical standards.
  • Maintain content consistency and ensure strict adherence to gFiber brand guidelines.
  • Assist with Spanish language translation review and basic content adaptation/localization.

 

At a minimum we’d like you to have: 

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of direct experience authoring, managing content modeling principles and execution within Contentful CMS.
  • 3 years of experience using core web technologies (HTML, CSS, JSON) and SEO/GEO practices.
  • Professional proficiency in Spanish to perform content localization and translation review.

 

It’s preferred if you have:

  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience with digital asset management (DAM) and cross-platform content publishing.
  • Project management skills with a track record of driving content delivery timelines across multiple digital channels.
  • Excellent English writing, editing, and proofreading skills.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail, particularly regarding content quality, structural integrity, and accuracy.

The US base salary for this full-time position is $100,100 - $161,500 + bonus + benefits. As pay varies by location, your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your targeted location during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Distributor Onboarding Project Manager - Dublin
jobs.jd_full:
Description

Distributor Onboarding Project Manager

Location: Dublin
Contract: FTC / Contract (likely 12-18 months)

This senior role leads a large-scale distributor onboarding and data transformation programme, migrating and uplifting around 3,000 distributor records and files into a new strategic platform.

The successful candidate will coordinate across Operations, Distribution, Compliance, Technology, Data Management and external vendors, overseeing offshore delivery teams and keeping senior stakeholders informed. We’re looking for 5+ years of financial services transformation experience, with strong data migration, vendor management and stakeholder skills.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of the distributor onboarding data migration project.
  • Manage the transfer, validation, cleansing, and uplift of approximately 3,000 distributor records/files into a new strategic system.
  • Coordinate activities across Operations, Distribution, Compliance, Technology, Data Management, and external vendors.
  • Oversee offshore/vendor teams (including eClerx) performing onboarding and data remediation activities.
  • Define project plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and governance frameworks.
  • Track programme progress and provide regular updates to senior stakeholders.
  • Manage RAID logs, issue resolution, and escalation processes.
  • Drive process improvements and identify opportunities to improve onboarding efficiency.
  • Ensure all onboarding activities comply with relevant regulatory and control requirements.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), data validation, and post-implementation activities.

Required Experience

  • Experience delivering business change, onboarding, data migration, or operational transformation projects within Financial Services.
  • Strong experience managing large-scale onboarding, KYC, client lifecycle management, distributor onboarding, fund operations, or asset management transformation initiatives.
  • Proven track record leading cross-functional projects involving Operations and Technology teams.
  • Experience managing third-party vendors and offshore delivery teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with exposure to Directors, Managing Directors, and senior business sponsors.
  • Experience with data migration, data governance, and data quality programmes.
  • Excellent project governance, reporting, and risk management capabilities.

How We Work:

Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, colour, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require any reasonable adjustments through your interview process, please use the designated space within the application questionnaire.

This is a 12 to 18 months fixed term contract role located in Dublin. As the selection and interview process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible. If your profile is selected, a member of our team will contact you within 4 weeks. Candidates must have the right to work in Ireland.

Expectations regarding hybrid working: 

As we are a Service Provider and Consulting firm servicing clients, our policy for physically working from the office (which may be the clients’ offices or our own offices depending on the client) aligns to what our clients’ policies and expectations are and these vary. Most of our clients now require a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, 2 days from home, and accordingly this is also the minimum expectation that Delta Capita require. However, some of our clients have now moved up to 4 days and even 5 days in the office and we require candidates to be flexible to meet our client demands.

Who We Are:

Delta Capita Group is a global managed services, consulting, and solutions provider with a unique combination of experience in Financial Services and technology innovation capability. Our mission is to reinvent the financial services value chain providing technology-based mutualised services for financial institutions for non-differentiating services.

Our 3 offerings are:

  • Managed Services
  • Consulting & Solutions
  • Technology

 

To know more about Delta Capita and our culture click here: Working at DC – Delta Capita
